description: Hiring SUMMARY for one company, read live from its public Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee job board. Use this when you need to know whether a company is hiring, how fast and in which teams: sales triggers, account research, investor or competitor signals. Do not use it to read the postings themselves (use company_jobs). Input: company (website domain, website URL or job-board URL); optional keywords narrow the counts to matching job titles. Returns results[0] with found, the job board detected (ATS and URL), signals (open roles, roles posted in the last 7 and 30 days, hiring level, counts by function and seniority, top departments and locations, remote share, the 10 newest jobs), a one-line summary, checkedAt and cached. found=false means no supported public board was found (for example a Workday-only company). Limits: one company per call; answers cached for 1 hour; 20 free companies a day per IP without a key, more with a paid key in the x-api-key header. Read-only: nothing is stored or sent.

company.description: The company to check, one per call: its website domain, website URL, or a job-board URL (boards.greenhouse.io/acme, jobs.lever.co/acme, jobs.ashbyhq.com/acme)

keywords.description: Optional job-title keywords; only jobs whose title contains any of them are counted

name: hiring_signals
title: Company hiring signals
